cropRecommendations.horizontalEvidence: Full music staff spans x39.95–576.09 except opening system begins 95.2; staff stroke extends approximately 39.79–576.25. Opening instrument labels begin beyond x45. Own clefs, notes, lyrics and figured bass fit these horizontal limits. Braces joining different parts are shared structural ink, not individual-part notation. Horizontal trim is source-verified; final output inspection is still pending.
cropRecommendations.algorithm: Use actual own-ink reach and source-reviewed detached markings. Fixed staff-space padding alone cannot preserve all lyrics, high arcs and multi-row figured bass while remaining compact. Keep an ambiguity warning where own and neighbor vertical ranges overlap.
cropRecommendations.avoid: Do not shrink guards to match automatic crops, and do not remove neighboring fragments if doing so clips any own ink. No whiteout masks are proposed.

independentTightSourceReview.method: Every source band viewed first with wider neighboring context, then with proposed tight boundaries and at least 12pt outside vertical context. Embedded glyph-outline and Bezier measurements support, but do not replace, manual musical ownership review; ambiguous low-string ownership assignments were corrected from source. Guards are fresh own-notation measurements with 0.25pt allowance for path stroke/edge sampling. New compact output has not yet been reviewed.
